stories.title: Create BEV C04 Knowledge Assessment with Electric Drive Train Diagnostics Scenarios
stories.description: Develop KA (Knowledge Assessment) for BEV C04 covering electric motor control systems, inverter operation, and torque vectoring diagnostics with scenario-based questions aligned to NOSS G452-010-3:2023 CoCU 4 assessment criteria.
acceptanceCriteria: KA file created at bev-diagnostic-rectification/C04/KA.md with minimum 8 scenario-based diagnostic questions covering motor, inverter, gearbox faults
Each question includes answer scheme with marks allocation and references specific CoCU 4 assessment criteria from NOSS standard
Questions include parameter calculation scenarios (e.g., torque distribution, efficiency losses at 80% load)
technicalNotes: File to create: bev-diagnostic-rectification/C04/KA.md (follows Buku Panduan WIM KA structure with TAJUK/TUJUAN/PENERANGAN)
Reference source: bev-diagnostic-rectification/00-noss-extract.md (CoCU 4 assessment criteria section)
Test command: uv run python validators/coverage_validator.py bev-diagnostic-rectification/C04/KA.md --check-assessment-coverage

stories.title: Create BEV C05 Knowledge Assessment with Supervisory Role Competency Questions
stories.description: Develop KA (Knowledge Assessment) for BEV C05 supervisory content covering team briefing, training delivery, and health/safety/environment (SHE) monitoring with competency-based questions aligned to NOSS CoCU 5 assessment criteria.
acceptanceCriteria: KA file created at bev-diagnostic-rectification/C05/KA.md with 10 competency-based questions across briefing, training delivery, and SHE responsibilities
Answer scheme includes 3-level supervisor competency rubric (basic/intermediate/advanced) per NOSS CoCU 5 standards
Questions use scenario format relevant to workshop supervision (e.g., 'Technician reports HV cable anomaly during shift—describe briefing actions')
technicalNotes: File to create: bev-diagnostic-rectification/C05/KA.md
Reference: bev-diagnostic-rectification/C05/PM-teori.md (supervisory content for context)
Test command: uv run python validators/coverage_validator.py bev-diagnostic-rectification/C05/KA.md --check-cu5-supervisor-topics

stories.title: Create Aesthetic C01 Performance Assessment with Client Consultation Scenario Rubrics
stories.description: Develop PA (Performance Assessment) for Aesthetic C01 with 3 interactive client consultation scenarios including health history assessment, skin analysis, and treatment recommendations with detailed rubrics for communication, clinical reasoning, and customer safety.
acceptanceCriteria: PA file created at aesthetic-services/C01/PA.md with 3 comprehensive consultation scenarios (each 15–20 minutes duration)
Each scenario includes 5-point scoring rubric for: communication effectiveness, relevant health/allergy data collection, skin condition assessment accuracy, and recommendation appropriateness
Rubric criteria aligned to NOSS S960-002-3:2020 CoCU 1 performance standards with pass/fail thresholds
technicalNotes: File to create: aesthetic-services/C01/PA.md (follows WIM PA structure with LANGKAH KERJA table and SENARAI SEMAK checklist)
Reference: aesthetic-services/00-noss-extract.md (CoCU 1 work activities and performance indicators)
Test command: uv run python validators/assessment_validator.py aesthetic-services/C01/PA.md --rubric-structure-check

stories.title: Create Aesthetic C02 Performance Assessment with Thermal Therapy Application Rubrics
stories.description: Develop PA (Performance Assessment) for Aesthetic C02 covering practical thermal therapy applications (steam, sauna, heat packs, herbal wraps) with rubrics for technique execution, client safety protocols, hygiene compliance, and treatment customization.
acceptanceCriteria: PA file created at aesthetic-services/C02/PA.md with 4 practical thermal therapy scenarios (steam application, sauna use, heat pack, herbal wrap)

Scoring rubric includes: hygiene protocol compliance (hand sanitization, towel sanitation per WIM standards), temperature safety (within NOSS-specified range), technique execution accuracy, and adaptive modifications for sensitive skin/contraindications
Each scenario specifies pass/fail evidence requirements and safety checkpoints from KK procedures
technicalNotes: File to create: aesthetic-services/C02/PA.md
Reference existing KK files: aesthetic-services/C02/KK-*.md (thermal therapy procedure steps and safety checkpoints)
Test command: uv run python validators/safety_validator.py aesthetic-services/C02/PA.md --thermal-therapy-safety-check

stories.title: Create Aesthetic C03 Performance Assessment with Manual Technique Demonstration Rubrics
stories.description: Develop PA (Performance Assessment) for Aesthetic C03 covering manual body massage techniques (effleurage, petrissage, tapotement, friction, vibration) with detailed rubrics for stroke quality, pressure modulation, anatomical accuracy, and real-time client feedback response.
acceptanceCriteria: PA file created at aesthetic-services/C03/PA.md with 3 massage technique scenarios targeting different body areas (back, shoulders, legs)
Rubric includes 5-level scoring for: pressure consistency (light/medium/deep as prescribed), stroke rhythm uniformity, anatomical landmark accuracy, and adaptive response to client feedback
Assessment includes video/observation checklist per NOSS S960-002-3:2020 CoCU 3 performance standards
technicalNotes: File to create: aesthetic-services/C03/PA.md
Reference: aesthetic-services/C03/KP-01.md (anatomy) and KK-* files (massage technique procedures)
Test command: uv run python validators/technique_validator.py aesthetic-services/C03/PA.md --massage-technique-rubric-validation

stories.title: Create Aesthetic C04 Knowledge Assessment with Electrotherapy Safety Parameter Questions

stories.title: Build Bilingual Terminology Validator for BEV with Consistency Checking and Glossary Generation
stories.description: Create Python validator tool that scans all BEV KP, KT, KK, and assessment files for EN/BM bilingual terminology consistency, flags inconsistencies, generates glossary reports, and ensures compliance with master BEV terminology list.
acceptanceCriteria: Validator script created at validators/bev_terminology_validator.py with ability to check consistency of 50+ technical BEV terms across all documents (high-voltage, battery management system, thermal runaway, etc.)
Tool generates detailed CSV report listing inconsistent EN/BM pairs by file, line number, and CU location with 'found: X / expected: Y' format
Integration test confirms validator correctly identifies 10+ seeded terminology inconsistencies in test files
technicalNotes: File to create: validators/bev_terminology_validator.py (uses regex matching against master term list)
Reference: bev-diagnostic-rectification/_reference/bev-terminology-glossary.md (master EN/BM pairs)
Test command: uv run pytest tests/test_bev_terminology_validator.py -v

stories.title: Build Bilingual Terminology Validator for IT with Consistency Checking and Glossary Reporting
stories.description: Create Python validator tool that scans all IT Level 3/4/5 KP, KT, KK files for EN/BM IT terminology consistency (server/pelayan, network/rangkaian, database/pangkalan data, etc.) and flags inconsistencies by file, level, and context.
acceptanceCriteria: Validator script created at validators/it_terminology_validator.py checking 40+ IT technical terms with level-aware differentiation (Level 3 basic vs. Level 5 enterprise terms)
Tool generates JSON report with term usage frequency, inconsistency flags, and recommended standardization per NOSS guidelines with file locations
Test confirms validator correctly flags 'server' vs. 'pelayan' inconsistencies and suggests standardization across levels
technicalNotes: File to create: validators/it_terminology_validator.py
Reference: it-computer-system/_reference/it-terminology-glossary.md (master IT EN/BM pairs organized by level)
Test command: uv run pytest tests/test_it_terminology_validator.py::test_level_aware_terminology -v

stories.title: Create KT Question Diversity Analyzer with Question Type Distribution Metrics and Recommendations
stories.description: Build Python tool to analyze all KT (assignment/knowledge) files across BEV, Aesthetic, and IT, classifying questions by type (MCQ, short answer, scenario, calculation, matching, true/false) and generating diversity metrics with rebalancing recommendations.
acceptanceCriteria: Analyzer script created at validators/question_diversity_analyzer.py that classifies 200+ questions by type with accuracy threshold of 95% (validated against manual sample)
Generates HTML/JSON report showing question type distribution by subject and CU with flags for 'too few scenario' (<20% per CU) or 'too many MCQ' (>40% per CU)
Recommends specific question type replacements to achieve optimal distribution: 30% MCQ / 30% scenario / 20% short answer / 20% calculation
technicalNotes: File to create: validators/question_diversity_analyzer.py with classify_question_type() function using keyword heuristics
Test command: uv run pytest tests/test_question_diversity_analyzer.py::test_classify_question_types -v

stories.title: Create KK Step-by-Step Safety Validator with Checkpoint Auditing and Gap Flagging
stories.description: Build validator tool to scan all KK (work sheet) procedural steps in BEV and Aesthetic and verify that critical operations include required safety checkpoints (PPE, hazard check, approval gates) per NOSS standards with detailed gap reports.
acceptanceCriteria: Validator script created at validators/kk_safety_checkpoint_validator.py with required_checkpoints dict for BEV high-voltage work (PPE verification, insulation test, ground continuity) and Aesthetic therapy (hygiene, contraindication screening, client comfort confirmation)
Tool flags missing checkpoints at mandatory steps and suggests insertion locations with reference to NOSS safety standards; generates HTML report with risk assessment for each gap
Integration test confirms tool correctly identifies 8+ missing safety checkpoints in seeded BEV/Aesthetic test files
technicalNotes: File to create: validators/kk_safety_checkpoint_validator.py with required_checkpoints dict and safety_risk_map for each subject
Test command: uv run pytest tests/test_kk_safety_validator.py::test_detect_missing_hv_safety_checkpoints -v

stories.title: Build WIM Markdown to DOCX Export Pipeline with JPK Format Compliance and Style Templates
stories.description: Develop Python export pipeline that converts validated WIM .md files (KP, KT, KK, PM, PA, KA) to .docx format with proper JPK Buku Panduan WIM Edisi 2020 styling: header boxes (NOSS code, CU, doc type), colored paper types, TAJUK/TUJUAN/PENERANGAN sections, proper fonts, margins, and page numbering.
acceptanceCriteria: Export script created at build/wim_md_to_docx.py accepting input .md file and outputting .docx with correct JPK formatting including header box with NOSS code, CU number, document type code, and sequential page numbering
Script supports --style flag for color-coded paper types: KP (white), KT (pink), KK (blue), PA (light blue), KA (pink), PM (yellow) with embedded watermark
Output .docx preserves markdown structure (headers, lists, tables) and validates against WIM formatting checklist before export; test file: bev-diagnostic-rectification/C01/KP-01.md
technicalNotes: File to create: build/wim_md_to_docx.py using python-docx library (for .docx creation) and pandoc (for .md parsing); template file: _reference/wim-docx-template.docx

Test command: uv run python build/wim_md_to_docx.py bev-diagnostic-rectification/C01/KP-01.md --style KP --output test_output.docx && uv run pytest tests/test_wim_export.py::test_docx_header_compliance -v

stories.title: Create Assessment Question Bank Indexer with Full-Text Search and Competency Tagging
stories.description: Build Python indexing tool that catalogs all assessment questions (KA, KT) across BEV, Aesthetic, and IT with rich metadata (subject, level, CU, question type, cognitive level, NOSS competency code) and enables SQL-based search by competency, difficulty, or topic.
acceptanceCriteria: Indexer script created at tools/question_bank_indexer.py that parses all KA/KT .md files and builds SQLite database (questions.db) with schema: question_id, subject, cu, level, qtype, cognitive_level (remember/understand/apply/analyze/evaluate), keywords, noss_code, answer_key
CLI supports search: `uv run python tools/question_bank_indexer.py search --subject BEV --cu C01 --level apply` returns matching questions with result count and difficulty distribution
Full-text search on question text and answer key with keyword highlighting; test confirms indexing of 200+ questions with sub-100ms search latency
technicalNotes: File to create: tools/question_bank_indexer.py; database: questions.db (SQLite, created at runtime in project root)
Test command: uv run pytest tests/test_question_indexer.py::test_index_and_search -v

stories.title: Build NOSS CoCU Requirement Traceability Reporter with Coverage Gap Analysis and Over-Testing Detection
stories.description: Develop Python reporter that maps each assessment question (KA, KT) to specific NOSS CoCU requirements (related knowledge items, work activities), generates interactive traceability matrix, and highlights uncovered requirements and over-represented test areas.
acceptanceCriteria: Reporter script created at validators/traceability_reporter.py that cross-references assessment questions against NOSS CoCU extract files (00-noss-extract.md) with many-to-many mapping (question → multiple CoCU requirements)

Output: Interactive HTML report showing traceability matrix (questions × NOSS requirements) with coverage percentage by CU, gap flags ('Requirement X.Y uncovered by any assessment'), and over-testing flags ('Requirement X.Y tested 5+ times')
Report includes actionable recommendations: 'Create KT question to cover Requirement C01.K1.5' or 'Consolidate 3 redundant questions covering Requirement C02.W3'
technicalNotes: File to create: validators/traceability_reporter.py; reads from {subject}/00-noss-extract.md for requirement definitions and maps to all assessment .md files
Test command: uv run python validators/traceability_reporter.py --subject BEV --output report.html && uv run pytest tests/test_traceability_reporter.py::test_gap_detection -v
